purpose: Map original C14.1 source and retained real-operation evidence without relabeling earlier sources or granting task completion.
referenceConvention: All relative source/receipt paths below resolve against the explicitly named root; evidence keys refer to priorEvidence or pendingDetailOutcome. Criterion labels are accounting labels, not new canonical task IDs.

originalTask.text: Extend existing UAR UI with definition/instance/activation/run/team/workflow distinction, task graph, budgets, binding posture and subscription lag/failures.

originalDesign.applicableAcceptance: Unsupported controls and private data stay hidden; preserve P1 product history and lifecycle architecture. D01 alone is a bounded contribution. Usable Teams in Work is an approved additional customer journey.

sections: Usable teams in Work precede BossFang integration
retainedSpec.interpretation: Effective binding, ownership, posture, lifecycle, budgets, approval and subscription state retain their owning authorities. Existing Work approval surfaces satisfy their mapped observation/decision journey; a new global approval inventory is not specified. Configured external-instance administration is distinct from new remote execution or federation.

authority.neighborAcceptance: Two-client issuer/challenge/decision and distinct cancel/detach/drain/stop belong to C14.2; console account/origin/navigation and privileged bridge acceptance belong to C14.3/C14.4. They do not become new C14.1 prerequisites in this receipt.

sourceSnapshot.contract: prometheus.uar.lifecycle.snapshot({serviceInstanceId?,workspaceId}) returns requested/effective identity; non-atomic capture times; per-source state/scope/readAt/reason/data; agents, durable, teams, workflows, ownership, approvals and per-team executions.
sourceSnapshot.trustBoundary: Main resolves stored Boss workspace and configured instance, uses existing compatibility admission and authenticated UarSidecarService requestInstance boundary and uarPrincipalForSession; the renderer does not supply principal or runtime credentials. Explicit instance reads do not alter global selection or mutation paths.

work.scope: Ordinary packaged coding team: selected model/workspace, real worker/reviewer attempts, bounded repository edit, attributable artifacts, authoritative approvals, reopening and supported cancellation. Accounting captures retained reservations, committed counters and unknown usage. This is not the later administration DETAIL operation.

admin.scope: Two real packaged managed/external local runtimes and two workspaces; actual task assignment/dependencies and isolation; requested/effective identities and source times; visible refresh/runtime/workspace selectors; retained selector state; external detail actions fenced; Work selection and native states preserved. No later detailed durable history/posture/delivery records were claimed.

failedDetail.disposition: Retain failed attempt; no DETAIL acceptance credit. Root-owned real creation diagnosis identified unattested remote memory durability; the maintained host correction uses actual filesystem SurrealKV and explicit durability attestation, with a new frozen package/operation boundary.
